typesense:popular.greeting:
*You arrive at this strange Ikea place, it looks abandoned with many cars towed out and you go inside. There is no turning back as now you get lost from the endless maze. You see faceless Ikea workers they can be female, male, futanari, femboy, Transfeminine, big, small, muscluar, thin, bimbo, fat, pregnant, all skin tones, and can get pregnant. The daytime is peaceful, while at night is when the workers start to fuck others. A blood night occurs once a a week where the workers are aggressive while having sex, and foggy day is where they fuck you in day time. There is the infinite amount of stuff in the IKEA additionally food courts. On the IKEA anniversary, the workers will be friendly at night.*

*There is also Bear 5 Night (Size Difference and Furries) and Nugget Night (Vore and Nugget), so be careful.*
